statement: The census read all 88 files of organism/scale-52000 (5126010 lines) as text and ran it in 7 shards of 1 cells files, one at a time, each shard loading only its own cells (mode cut: an owned cell misses the mail of every cell outside its shard, so this is an approximation and never the bar), under a cap of 8000 MB resident per shard; peak rss per shard 3026.8 MB, 1758.4 MB, 1196.8 MB, 1250.1 MB, 1314.4 MB, 2146.6 MB, 2179.6 MB, wall 70.8 s. It drove the organism 20 ticks with nothing injected, then ran the hosted algebra and sequence problems (112 more ticks; algebra 25 of 36, sequence 22 of 22). Of 416000 declared cells 205246 ran (49.34 percent) and 59998 emitted; of 4656829 declared edges 631015 delivered (13.55 percent). Of 5124836 declaration lines 886632 declared something that ran or delivered and 4238204 are dead; 887806 of 5126010 lines are load bearing (17.32 percent). Not exact: cut shards.
drive: one brain.tick(1) per event loop turn per shard, nothing injected, runtime/kernels.mjs installed; then the hosted algebra and sequence problems into the cells the whole organism picks (tasks/host.mjs nameCells), on every shard, with the whole schedule

ratio.how: peak rss of 98 progress samples up to tick 130

live.phases: the drive ticks plus the hosted algebra and sequence problems, sharded cut
